Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I posted that reply in #strategic-pod.

His July 1 update first said 300. A few minutes later he corrected it: the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. The production roster showed 280 active seats as of Jul 1, and Ruth acknowledged 280 as the corrected number.

His correction calls it "Nadia's old industrial account" instead of naming Vantorre. It follows straight on from the Vantorre update, so I read it as the same account.
